name: Carcassonne Base Game
description: Standard 72 base game landscape tiles across 24 canonical configurations (letters A through X), including the starting tile.

tiles.name: Monastery with Road
tiles.description: Monastery in field with a single road exiting to the South.

tiles.name: Monastery in Field
tiles.description: Monastery completely surrounded by an open field.

tiles.name: City with Shield
tiles.description: Unified city occupying all four sides with a coat of arms (shield).

tiles.name: City Edge with Straight Road (Start Tile layout)
tiles.description: City edge on North; straight road running East to West; field on South. 1 tile is the official starting tile with dark reverse.

tiles.name: City Edge
tiles.description: Single city edge on North bordered by open fields on East, South, and West. 1 instance depicts a garden.

tiles.name: Straight City Tube with Shield
tiles.description: Continuous city connecting North and South across the tile, with a coat of arms. Fields on East and West are divided.

tiles.name: Straight City Tube
tiles.description: Continuous city connecting North and South across the tile, without coat of arms. Fields on East and West are divided.

tiles.name: Two Separate City Edges (Opposite)
tiles.description: Two distinct, unconnected city edges on North and South. A continuous field connects East and West between them. 1 instance features a garden.

tiles.name: Two Separate City Edges (Adjacent)
tiles.description: Two distinct, unconnected city edges on North and East. Continuous field wraps from South and West through the corner gap between cities. 1 instance features a garden.

tiles.name: City Edge with Curved Road (Turning East)
tiles.description: City edge on North; curved road connecting East and South edges. Outer field connects West to North and South; separate inner field in SE corner.

tiles.name: City Edge with Curved Road (Turning West)
tiles.description: City edge on North; curved road connecting South and West edges. Outer field connects East to North and South; separate inner field in SW corner.

tiles.name: City Edge with 3-Way Road Junction
tiles.description: City edge on North; 3 independent roads meeting at a central village crossroad from East, South, and West. Divides fields into 3 regions.

tiles.name: Connected City Corner with Shield
tiles.description: Unified city occupying North and East corner with a coat of arms. Continuous field on South and West. 1 instance features a garden.

tiles.name: Connected City Corner
tiles.description: Unified city occupying North and East corner without coat of arms. Continuous field on South and West. 1 instance features a garden.

tiles.name: Connected City Corner with Shield and Road Corner
tiles.description: Unified city covering North and East corner with coat of arms; curved road connecting South and West. Two separate fields (buffer between city/road and inner SW corner).

tiles.name: Connected City Corner and Road Corner
tiles.description: Unified city covering North and East corner without coat of arms; curved road connecting South and West. Two separate fields (buffer between city/road and inner SW corner).

tiles.name: 3-Sided City with Shield
tiles.description: Unified city occupying North, East, and West edges with a coat of arms. Open field on South edge.

tiles.name: 3-Sided City
tiles.description: Unified city occupying North, East, and West edges without coat of arms. Open field on South edge. 1 instance features a garden.

tiles.name: 3-Sided City with Shield and Terminating Road
tiles.description: Unified city on North, East, West with coat of arms; road entering South edge terminating at city gate. Road divides field into two corner regions.

tiles.name: 3-Sided City with Terminating Road
tiles.description: Unified city on North, East, West without coat of arms; road entering South edge terminating at city gate. Road divides field into two corner regions.

tiles.name: Straight Road
tiles.description: Continuous straight road connecting North and South edges, dividing fields into East and West regions. 1 instance features a garden.

tiles.name: Curved Road
tiles.description: Curved road connecting South and West edges. Divides field into a large outer region (North/East) and an inner SW corner region. 1 instance features a garden.

tiles.name: 3-Way Road Junction
tiles.description: Three independent road segments meeting at a central village crossroad from East, South, and West. Divides fields into 3 distinct regions.

tiles.name: 4-Way Crossroads
tiles.description: Four independent road segments entering from all 4 edges meeting at a crossroads. Divides field into 4 distinct corner regions.

field_encoding: Fields are listed as boundary slots of the 12-slot model (N0 N1 N2 west→east, E0 E1 E2 north→south, S0 S1 S2 east→west, W0 W1 W2 south→north; roads/rivers use the middle slot X1). "INNER" marks an enclosed field touching no edge. Fields are derived from edges, cities, roads and rivers plus the hints road_ends_at / merge_barriers; tests assert both stay in sync.
